notes:
New TV layout, modeled on TVlok and TiviMate. The phone and tablet layouts stay as they were.

Live TV fills the screen, with the preview and program details above the guide. OK plays in the preview, OK again goes full screen and holding OK opens options. Hold Left for earlier programs. Number keys jump to a channel in the category you're viewing.

Left opens categories, then playlists if you have more than one, then the menu. Back opens the menu. This replaces the icon rail, the Guide/Channels switch and the Source button.

Movies and Shows on TV open on All, with the selected title's details above rows by category. The previous page is now On TV & for you. Live TV pauses while you're in them.

If you saved the 9 or 12 row guide on TV, it's kept, and those layouts have no preview.

Known TV issues, also in the previous version: adding or editing a provider with only a remote can get stuck in the text fields, and on Home, Down can stop at Now playing when there's no featured banner below it.

Tested on Android TV and foldable emulators, not yet on a real TV or Fire TV.
